To drive ecommerce growth, USA Kilts, a niche retailer of authentic Scottish attire, partnered with Adtaxi. Despite a strong organic social following and a physical storefront, the brand had reached a growth plateau. Technical hurdles and market challenges limited its ability to scale online, prompting the need for a strategic partner to unlock new revenue opportunities. The goal was ambitious: achieve an 8x return on ad spend (ROAS).

USA Kilts’ primary challenge was scaling in an ultra-niche market. While its craftsmanship set it apart, digital advertising performance lagged due to reliance on limited channels, ongoing product feed and tracking issues, and unsophisticated targeting. Frequent website updates by the webmaster often disrupted pixels and data feeds, resulting in unreliable performance metrics and hampering optimization efforts.

To move forward, USA Kilts needed more than campaign execution. The brand required a partner capable of stabilizing the technical foundation and transforming ecommerce from a supplemental channel into a primary revenue driver, all while working toward the 8x ROAS benchmark.

Adtaxi implemented a comprehensive, human-powered approach designed to expand reach, strengthen infrastructure, and drive conversions. Recognizing that algorithms alone would not solve the problem, the team took a hands-on role that combined technical rigor with strategic creativity.

The first priority was stabilizing the data ecosystem. Adtaxi conducted daily product feed monitoring to ensure accuracy and implemented custom scripts for precise performance tracking. A direct, collaborative relationship with the client’s webmaster was established, along with strict pixel quality checks following every site update. This foundational work ensured every advertising dollar could be accurately measured against revenue.

With reliable data in place, Adtaxi expanded USA Kilts’ digital presence across paid social platforms, including Meta and TikTok, as well as programmatic display. Leveraging The Trade Desk (TTD), the team reached high-intent audiences beyond the brand’s existing followers. Dynamic retargeting campaigns used the now-stable product feed to deliver personalized ads featuring specific products users had shown interest in. This diversified, full-funnel approach allowed USA Kilts to engage customers at every stage of the buying journey.

The results exceeded expectations. The campaign delivered an 11.85x ROAS, which was 48% above the original target, generating over $500,000 in revenue and driving 1,590 purchases. Year over year, performance improved by $2.86, far surpassing projections. With an average order value of $337, the campaign successfully attracted high-value customers and translated strategic digital execution into measurable growth.

Ongoing optimization played a key role, including strategic budget allocation, A/B creative testing, and gender-specific custom targeting. By continually refining retargeting efforts and making data-driven adjustments, Adtaxi demonstrated the impact of a personalized, invested approach. Today, USA Kilts remains a valued Adtaxi client, reflecting a partnership built on trust, technical excellence, and sustained performance.
